g.text: [Employer requests delegated, entity-scoped access through the platform (ADR-043)]
issues a UCAN delegation naming the employer's DID,
and an expiration (ADR-043 -- capped to the registrar's own authority)
-- ADR-036's mechanism, reused for a delegation exchange (ADR-043)
[Student instead hands the employer a self-contained, offline-verifiable presentation (ADR-036, reused)]
(at issuance time, out of band) obtains a W3C
signed by the institution's issuer DID (ADR-036's DID primitive)
and wrapped in a UCAN invocation chain (ADR-036's UCAN primitive)
(file/QR/wallet -- no network call to this platform at all)
verify the signature chain and issuer DID
locally, entirely offline -- no API call, no Gateway,
no AccessLogEntry (this path never touches the platform)
